name: raguard-mini-eval-v1
description: Tiny labelled eval set for retrieval metrics. Corpus is a general-knowledge FAQ so the eval stays domain-neutral; the mental-health demo shows the guardrails side.

chunks.text: The water cycle describes how water evaporates from oceans and lakes, condenses into clouds, falls as precipitation, and returns through rivers and groundwater. The sun powers the cycle.
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen. Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs the light energy.

The French Revolution began in 1789 when financial crisis and inequality led the Estates-General to convene. It ended the monarchy, produced the Declaration of the Rights of Man, and eventually Napoleon's rise.

Compound interest is interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods. Money grows exponentially because each period's interest earns interest itself.
The mitochondria are membrane-bound organelles that generate most of the chemical energy a cell needs as ATP through cellular respiration. They have their own DNA and are inherited maternally.

In economics, inflation is a sustained rise in the general price level of goods and services, usually measured with a consumer price index. Central banks typically target a low, stable rate around two percent.
The HTTP protocol defines how clients and servers exchange web resources. Key methods include GET for retrieval, POST for submission, PUT and DELETE for modification. Status codes report outcomes.

Machine learning models generalise from training data to unseen examples. Overfitting occurs when a model memorises training noise and fails on new data; regularisation and held-out validation mitigate it.
The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, off Australia's northeast coast. It supports thousands of species and faces bleaching threats from rising sea temperatures.

A hash function maps data of arbitrary size to a fixed-size value. Good cryptographic hashes are deterministic, fast to compute, and infeasible to reverse, making them central to password storage and data integrity.
